resultJson.title: Add Scala 3 file manipulation sample using java.nio
resultJson.body:
Adds `src/main/scala/files/FileManipulation.scala`, a sample showing basic file operations with `java.nio` and `scala.util.Using`: write, append, read, copy and move, file size, and directory listing.

Failures are returned as `Either[FileFail, T]` rather than thrown. `FileFail` separates `NotFound` from other `IOException`s.

The `fileManipulationDemo` main runs the operations in a temp directory that is deleted afterwards.

The diff also adds `.orca/runs/a32d6a8fc303.progress.json`, a run-progress file from the tooling that created the branch.
